lines.speaker: Commentator A
lines.text: Ashford Athletic have barely had a sniff, but that first goal was a lovely long move of about ten passes.

lines.speaker: Commentator B
lines.text: Westvale City have had well over sixty percent of the ball and still look short of ideas.

lines.speaker: Commentator A
lines.text: Ashford Athletic have had more shots than Westvale City today, that's the story.
